commands.name: search-crates
commands.summary: Search Rust crates on docs.rs by keyword, optionally sorted by downloads or recency

commands.name: resolve-crate
commands.summary: I'm Feeling Lucky: jump to the best-matching crate for a query and return its exact name and latest version

commands.name: get-crate
commands.summary: Get a crate's docs.rs overview page: title, description, documentation link and coverage

commands.name: get-crate-status
commands.summary: Check whether docs built successfully for a crate version (JSON: doc_status, resolved version)

commands.name: list-crate-builds
commands.summary: List the docs build history of a crate version: rustc version, date, duration, memory, result

commands.name: list-crate-features
commands.summary: List the Cargo feature flags of a crate version

commands.name: list-crate-versions
commands.summary: List all published versions of a crate with their release dates

commands.name: list-source-files
commands.summary: List the files and folders in a crate's published source package (root or a subfolder)

commands.name: get-source-file
commands.summary: Read the contents of one file in a crate's source package, e.g. Cargo.toml or src/lib.rs

commands.name: get-crate-docs
commands.summary: Read a crate's rustdoc landing page: crate docs text, version, permalink

commands.name: list-crate-items
commands.summary: List every public item (structs, enums, traits, functions, types, constants) of a crate, with links to their doc pages

commands.name: get-doc-item
commands.summary: Read the rustdoc page of one item (struct, trait, fn...) inside a crate

commands.name: list-releases
commands.summary: Browse docs.rs release listings: recent releases, top crates by GitHub stars, recent build failures, or failures sorted by stars

commands.name: get-releases-feed
commands.summary: Get the Atom feed of the most recently built crate releases (structured JSON)

commands.name: list-build-queue
commands.summary: List the crate releases waiting in the docs.rs build queue

commands.name: list-builds-in-progress
commands.summary: List the crate docs builds currently running and how long they have been running
